overview_description.description:
FlutterFlow, founded in 2020, is a ground breaking low-code, visual development platform designed to simplify the creation of native mobile and web applications. With over 400,000 users and thousands of apps deployed to app stores, FlutterFlow empowers product teams to create stunning UIs and generate clean code with ease. The platform's one-click deployment feature accelerates launch timelines, while remaining fully extensible with custom code. Millions of end users are served through FlutterFlow-built apps. This cutting-edge platform streamlines application development and enables businesses to scale rapidly and efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: FlutterFlow is a low-code, visual application development platform for native mobile and web applications.

product.name: FlutterFlow Visual Application Builder
product.description: A low-code platform for visually building native mobile and web applications using pre-designed UI elements and a visual logic editor.

product.name: FlutterFlow AI Features
product.description: AI-powered tools for generating UI components, pages, and app functionality from sketches or text prompts within the FlutterFlow platform.

product.name: Data Integration and Backend Connectivity
product.description: Integration with Firebase, Supabase, and RESTful APIs to connect apps to databases and third-party services for data management and extended functionality.

product.name: Collaboration and Team Development Tools
product.description: Features that enable multiple users to collaborate on app development projects with branching, commenting, task assignment, and live sharing.

product.name: Code Export and Ownership
product.description: Capability to export the generated Flutter code from projects, allowing users to own, edit, and extend their app code without vendor lock-in.

product.name: App Deployment and Multi-Platform Support
product.description: Tools to build responsive apps that deploy to iOS, Android, and web platforms with minimal effort.
